title: LAND PORT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (VINIMAY)
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

LAND PORT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (VINIMAY)

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 4:06PM by PIB Delhi

The Land Port Management System (VINIMAY)  has been operationalized at 10 Integrated Check Posts (ICPs). State-wise details are as under:-

The Land Port Management System (LPMS) has been integrated with the Unified Logistics Platform (ULIP), ICEGATE, the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), and the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. Land Ports Management System has been developed as a digital platform for management of operations at all existing and future ICPs.

This was stated by the Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs Shri Nityanand Rai in a written reply to a question in the Lok Sabha.
